_comment: Chessboard item 2 (S32, docs/chessboard_design.md): per position_code BASE home ANCHOR on the 30-zone board (data/config/zone_grid.json), neutral playstyle. The anchor is a CONTINUOUS point — item 3's occupancy kernel spreads it into graded primary/secondary/tertiary zones. Keyed on positions.position_code (23 codes); StatsBomb positions map ~1:1 for validation. Lane side comes from positions.flank; central defenders/mids carrying an L/R flank sit in HALF-SPACES, wide defenders/wingers/wide-mids in WING lanes.
_convention: band_pos in [0,5]: 0=B1 own-goal ... 5=B6 opp-box; a .5 value = the edge BETWEEN two bands. lane_pos in [0,4]: 0=LW, 1=LHS, 2=C, 3=RHS, 4=RW; a .5 value = the edge between two lanes. Integer = cell centre. nearest cell_id = round(band_pos)*5 + round(lane_pos).
_multiplicity_note: When a formation fields N>1 slots of the SAME central code (e.g. 4-2-3-1 has two 'DM'; a two-'ST' or two-'CM' system), they are fanned LATERALLY around the anchor's lane_pos at ASSEMBLY time. That is a formation rule and lives in item 3 (occupancy build), NOT in this static map — a code's anchor is identical regardless of how many are played.

DM.note: screen in front of back line, central

ST.note: B5/B6 edge central (offside-realistic, not camped in box)

FW.note: generic forward fallback, B5/B6 edge central
